items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview

ctx.x: Oh is that so? Well, anyway, I had a little gig, I had my own trio at the Bohemia, and even Birdland, one of the owners ... I forgot the name; the fellow that

got killed; he liked me, and he'd have me down there on Monday night, you know, with my own group, and I tried to get reliable guys to make it, and I was doing very well, you know, and everybody I ran into, there'd be somebody wanting me to work with them.
